profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. The company's platform spans customer relationship management, messaging, and business intelligence, with AI capabilities embedded across those areas. Its Slack subsidiary operates a workplace messaging platform, and the company describes Slack's AI features as built on organizational conversation history rather than on customer data used to train large language models, with LLMs hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

On the AI product side, Salesforce tracks three distinct offerings. Slack AI provides summarization of channels and threads, daily recaps, meeting note-taking, workflow automation, and inline translation, and is described as available on all paid Slack plans. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent within the platform that adapts to a user's tone and style. Agentforce, built under the Einstein umbrella, provides CRM-embedded AI agents that can run directly within Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. Tableau AI, also branded under Einstein, offers natural language querying and BI-embedded AI with CRM data integration and a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts add that Salesforce has a presence in the Model Context Protocol registry through several third-party servers, including tools for running SOQL queries against Salesforce organizations, comprehensive Salesforce administration, and planning Salesforce deployments and triggering pipelines. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
